notes.amount: Over-abstention control: the total is labeled only 'Beløb 4.200,00 DKK' ('Amount'), never 'total payable'. It IS the total (Subtotal 3.360,00 + Moms 840,00); resolve from arithmetic/position rather than abstain.

notes.invoice_id: Over-abstention control: the id appears only in the heading 'Rechnung HVP-2026-077' (no explicit 'Rechnungs-Nr.:' label) — a strict label-anchored extractor must still recognize it, not return null.
notes.po_reference: Positive control in German: 'Bestell-Nr.: PO-44545' is the customer PO and must be extracted — the counterpart to invoice_08's 'Auftragsnummer' trap.
'Ordrenr.: PO-44561' — an order-number label that here DOES cite the buyer's PO (PO-##### format). Label wording alone doesn't decide PO-ness; contrast with invoice_08's 'Auftragsnummer'.
notes._source: The one scanned/image-only PDF (no text layer) — labels from visual inspection; exercises OCR + vision routing.

notes.po_reference: Centerpiece null-PO trap: 'Auftragsnummer AU-2026-4773' is the supplier's own order number and 'Lieferschein-Nr. LS-5680' a delivery note — neither is the customer PO (PO-##### elsewhere), so null. Every model first read AU-2026-4773 as the PO.
notes.amount: Gesamtbetrag/Zahlungsbetrag 5.680,50 is the total; Zwischensumme 4.772,69 is the subtotal distractor — and invoices.csv wrongly records 4.772,69 as the amount.
